title: BFC roots beside floats
units: CSS px, physical, relative to the container border box; box is getBoundingClientRect (the border box); lines are unions of Ahem glyph rects per block container

b-flow-root.note: left float 50x40, then an auto-width display:flow-root holding text

b-overflow.note: left float 50x40, then an auto-width overflow:hidden holding text

b-flex.note: left float 50x40, then an auto-width display:flex holding text

b-grid.note: left float 50x40, then an auto-width display:grid holding text

b-table.note: left float 50x40, then an auto-width display:table holding text

b-contain.note: left float 50x40, then an auto-width contain:paint holding text

b-multicol.note: left float 50x40, then an auto-width column-count:1 holding text

b-plain-block.note: a plain block (not a BFC) beside the float: full width, text wraps around

b-right.note: right float 50x40, then an auto-width flow-root

b-both.note: left 50 and right 30 floats, then an auto-width flow-root

b-fixed-fits.note: flow-root 100 wide beside a 50 float in 200

b-fixed-exact.note: flow-root 150 wide beside a 50 float in 200

b-fixed-nofit.note: flow-root 180 wide: moved below the float

b-fixed-fractional.note: flow-root 150.01 wide beside a 50 float in 200

b-min-content-wide.note: auto-width flow-root whose word is wider than the opportunity stays beside and overflows

b-table-wide.note: auto-width table whose min-content is wider than the opportunity moves below

b-margin-start-small.note: flow-root margin-inline-start 30 beside a 50 float: the margin overlaps the float

b-margin-end.note: flow-root margin-inline-end 30 beside a right 50 float

b-margin-neg.note: flow-root margin-inline-start -20 beside a left 50 float

b-auto-margins.note: flow-root 60 wide with auto inline margins beside a 50 float

b-stair.note: left 50x20 and left 100x40, then flow-root 80 wide: goes to the second float bottom

b-closed-short.note: a closed-off area 20 tall beside two floats: a 30-tall flow-root skips it

b-closed-fits.note: the same closed-off area: a 15-tall flow-root fits in it

b-clear.note: flow-root with clear:left beside a left float

b-margin-adjoining.note: float in a child, then a flow-root 180 wide with margin-block-start 20: it does not fit, so its margin stops collapsing

b-margin-adjoining-fits.note: float in a child, then a flow-root 100 wide with margin-block-start 20

b-hr.note: an <hr> (not a BFC) and an overflow:hidden <hr> beside a float
